function.name: lookup_customer
function.description: Find the caller's account by the phone number on the account. Call it as soon as the caller says the phone number on their account; never for a callback number. Its result is the sentence for the caller: already spoken, or read out word for word when spoken is false.

phone.description: The ten-digit phone number the caller stated, digits only. Only a number the caller said on this call.

messages.content: Sure, let me look that up.
Thanks for bearing with me, almost there.
Sorry, I'm having trouble reaching our claims system right now. I can have a representative call you back, or you can try again in a few minutes. Which would you prefer?
